mechanism: Infliximab (TNF-α inhibitor) increases infection risk including CMV, while foscarnet is used to treat CMV infections; concurrent use increases risk of severe infections and potential immune dysregulation due to additive immunosuppression.
action: Use foscarnet cautiously in patients on infliximab; monitor closely for signs of disseminated CMV infection and other opportunistic infections; consider temporary discontinuation of infliximab if treating active CMV disease.
